000.$description: Instant change. No user perceptible transition.

100.$description: Micro-interactions default e.g button state changes.

150.$description: Moderately fast duration for small changes requiring user attention.

200.$description: Default or baseline transition speed for general use.

300.$description: Slower than the baseline duration for more expressive or larger animations.

400.$description: Slower than the baseline duration for larger UI animations.

500.$description: Slower speed for page transitions and significant transformations.

linear.$description: For continuous motion such as loading animations

standard.$description: Default for elements moving within the view or screen
